_note: x402 endpoint catalog. Discovery is substring/keyword match over `name`, `description`, `tags`. `method` is GET or POST (case-insensitive). For POST/PUT/PATCH, `body_template` is sent as an application/json body. `{subject}` / `{token}` in `url` or in any string value of `body_template` is replaced with the token the user asked about. `cost_usd` is the expected price shown at confirmation; the REAL price is read from the endpoint's own 402 before anything is pulled, and is capped at `cost_usd * 1.5`. RUN `bun run scripts/x402-verify.ts` BEFORE ANY REAL-MONEY DEMO — it probes every entry's live 402 for free and is how the dead `token-risk` endpoint (502 from its own nginx) and the 50x-overstated Heurist prices were found. Sourced from the CDP x402 Bazaar (via x402scan) — see X402.md.

endpoints.name: Whale Flows
endpoints.description: Recent large transfers and net accumulation/distribution for a token, by wallet cohort, plus holder and market context.

endpoints.name: Smart Money Positioning
endpoints.description: What consistently-profitable wallets are buying and selling right now on Base, plus market-wide news and macro context.

endpoints.name: Token Analysis
endpoints.description: Spot price, 24h volume, pool liquidity depth and a written analysis of a Base token — the closest thing in the catalogue to a safety read on a ticker.

endpoints.name: Nansen Smart Money Netflow
endpoints.description: Nansen's Smart Money cohort — funds and consistently-profitable traders — and what they are net buying or selling on Base over the last 24h.

endpoints.name: Nansen Smart Money Holdings
endpoints.description: What Nansen's Smart Money wallets currently hold on Base, by token, with 24h balance change and share of holdings.

endpoints.name: Nansen Smart Money DEX Trades
endpoints.description: Individual DEX trades made by Nansen Smart Money wallets on Base — what they bought and sold, and for how much.

endpoints.name: Nansen Token Screener
endpoints.description: Screens Base tokens by Smart Money activity over the last 24h — the discovery endpoint for finding tokens rather than checking one.

endpoints.name: Nansen Token Holders
endpoints.description: Holder concentration for a Base token: who holds it, what share each controls, and which holders Nansen labels smart money. The strongest rug-risk read in the catalogue.

endpoints.name: Nansen Token Flows
endpoints.description: Inflows and outflows for one Base token over the last week, split by holder label — where the money is coming from and going to.

endpoints.name: Nansen Token DEX Trades
endpoints.description: Every DEX trade in one Base token over the last week, with the option to see only smart-money trades.

endpoints.name: Nansen Token Transfers
endpoints.description: Raw transfers of one Base token over the last week, including exchange deposits and withdrawals.

endpoints.name: Nansen Token PnL Leaderboard
endpoints.description: Which wallets made and lost the most on one Base token over the last week, realised and unrealised.

endpoints.name: Nansen Who Bought and Sold
endpoints.description: The wallets that bought and sold one Base token over the last week, with labels — the fastest read on who is behind a move.

endpoints.name: Nansen Wallet PnL Summary
endpoints.description: Profit and loss for one Base WALLET address over the last week — how a trader has actually done, not a token.

endpoints.name: Nansen Wallet Counterparties
endpoints.description: Who one Base WALLET address has been transacting with over the last week, grouped by wallet or entity.
